setup.title: Set up deploy
setup.description: Vibe Teamlead creates a private GitHub repository if the project has none, pushes the main branch, and connects it to a Vercel project. Every merge into main then goes to production.

needed.title: Needed from you
needed.github-app-install: Give the Vibe Teamlead GitHub App access to this repository on GitHub, then try again.
needed.vercel-git-access: Let Vercel’s GitHub App access this repository, then try again.
needed.vercel-existing-project: Vercel already has a project for this repository. Use it, or create a new one.
needed.non-github-remote: The project’s origin is not on GitHub. Deploy works with GitHub repositories only.
needed.public-repo-warning: {{repo}} is public: anyone can read its code.
needed.database-terms: Vercel needs you to accept the {{integration}} Marketplace terms before it adds the database. Read them first:
needed.database-dashboard: Finish adding the database in the Vercel dashboard, then come back.

database.title: Database
database.description: Add a free Postgres database (Neon) to the Vercel project. Its connection variables go to Production and Preview.
database.previewNote: Preview deployments may use this same database unless Neon’s preview branching is on. Documentation → Deploy says how to check.

variables.title: Variables
variables.githubUnavailable: GitHub secrets couldn’t be read, so the “In GitHub” marks may be missing.
variables.savedBoth: {{name}} saved to Vercel and as a GitHub secret.

variableDialog.title: Add variable
variableDialog.description: Saved to the Vercel project as a sensitive variable. The value is never shown again.
variableDialog.name: Name
variableDialog.valueHint: Capital letters, digits and underscores in the name. The value can’t be read back after saving.

errors.conflict: GitHub’s main has commits this Mac doesn’t have. Pull them into the project; the next merge then pushes.
errors.permissions: The Vibe Teamlead GitHub App isn’t allowed to push to this repository. Give it access on GitHub.
errors.no-connection: GitHub didn’t accept the sign-in. Sign in to GitHub again in Settings.
errors.unavailable: GitHub couldn’t be reached. The next merge tries again.

errors.request: The app couldn’t answer. Try again.
errors.no-connection: Not connected: sign in to GitHub or Vercel in Settings.
errors.permissions: The Vibe Teamlead GitHub App doesn’t have the permission this needs. Give it access on GitHub.
errors.forbidden: Vercel refused: your account has no access to this project or team.
errors.not-found: Something the app needs is gone on GitHub or Vercel, or the app has no access to it.
errors.rate-limit: GitHub or Vercel rate limit reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: GitHub or Vercel isn’t responding. Try again.
errors.git-not-connected: Vercel can’t reach the repository: grant Vercel’s GitHub App access to it.
errors.conflict: That name is already taken on GitHub or Vercel.
errors.bad-request: Vercel rejected the request. Check the name and the values, then try again.
errors.invalid: The project isn’t ready: it must be a git repository with a commit on its main branch, and the input must be valid.
errors.not-set-up: Set up deploy for this project first.
errors.cli: The Vercel CLI couldn’t finish. Try again.
errors.timeout: It took too long. Try again.
errors.saved-failed: It was done, but the app couldn’t save that. Try again to record it.
